title: Easy Bacon Fried Rice
description: This delicious bacon fried rice with bacon, egg, and green beans is a quick and easy side dish and a clever way to use leftover cooked rice.
ingredients: 1 cup frozen French-cut green beans, thawed
1 tablespoon soy sauce, or more to taste

steps.text: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally until just beginning to brown, about 7 minutes. Drain all but 1 to 2 teaspoons of bacon grease from the skillet. Add green beans, onion, and garlic. Sauté until bacon is crisp and green beans and onions are softened, about 3 minutes.
Push bacon mixture to one side of the skillet; heat sesame oil on the empty side, about 30 seconds. Pour in egg; cook until just set, about 1 minute. Stir into bacon mixture to combine.
Mix in rice. Stir in soy sauce until rice is evenly coated. Cook until rice is heated through, 3 to 5 minutes.
